rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that continues for a long time, including relationships, peace, or effects.

example.english: We hope this friendship can be lasting.
example.traditional: 我哋希望呢段友誼可以長久。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 ni1 dyun6 jau5 ji4 ho2 ji5 coeng4 gau2

rows.note: Use this specifically for products or materials that remain usable after prolonged use.

example.english: This phone case is lasting enough to survive years of use.
example.traditional: 呢個電話殼夠耐用，用幾年都冇問題。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 din6 waa2 hok3 gau3 noi6 jung6 jung6 gei2 nin4 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4
